en: Black‑and‑white street view labeled "Elsterwerda — Hauptstraße" showing a cobblestone main street lined with early‑20th‑century buildings and shopfronts. A church tower with a clock and tall spire rises prominently in the center background. Horse‑drawn carriages and a few pedestrians are visible further down the street. The image has margins and typography typical of an old photographic postcard.
